messages.subject: Time recording - March narratives outstanding
messages.plaintextBody:
Colleagues,

Our records show unposted time for March. Please ensure all March time is recorded with proper narratives by close on Thursday 2 April so we can run the month-end WIP report. Matters with significant unbilled time will be flagged to the responsible partner.

Thanks,
Accounts
